title.zh: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading
title.en: SEC grants temporary exemption for tokenized US stock trading

current_state.zh: The SEC approved a temporary Innovation Exemption allowing limited, permissioned trading of tokenized US National Market System stocks on onchain venues, subject to trading caps, transparency, recordkeeping, and technology safeguards.
current_state.en: The SEC approved a temporary Innovation Exemption allowing limited, permissioned trading of tokenized US National Market System stocks on onchain venues, subject to trading caps, transparency, recordkeeping, and technology safeguards.
